annotations.text:
AsapLocal — customer app splash

Both run the same 5s loop: promise animates in, resolves to the app icon, then lifts away to hand off to the dashboard. Tokens lifted from packages/ui/tailwind.preset.js — Inter, terracotta #c15f2a, espresso ground, real logo-mark.svg.

A · Trade ticker — leads on WHAT you can book, cycling the real seeded trades (cleaner, plumber, electrician, gardener).

Why: says what the product is in under two seconds, to someone who has never opened it.
Tradeoff: the ticker is the whole idea, so it needs the full ~2s — the least patient option if the app boots fast.

B · Radar sweep — leads on HOW it works: pros found near you. Reuses the pulsing-ring language already in the provider dashboard's radar map.

Why: more distinctive, and ties the two apps together visually.
Tradeoff: abstract — a first-time user may read it as generic 'searching' rather than local trades.

Hand-off frame — direction A's resting beat (it keeps A's warm glow, which B does not use), held still so the lockup can be judged without waiting for the loop. This is the last thing on screen before the dashboard mounts.
